com.esignal.jstandard.event

Class ConnectionAdapter

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.esignal.jstandard.event.ConnectionAdapter
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    ConnectionListener, java.util.EventListener

    public abstract class ConnectionAdapter
extends java.lang.Object
implements ConnectionListener
    Purpose of this abstract class is to provide empty method implementation for ConnectionListener.

    01-001-0007
    Author:

      • onDisconnecting

        public void onDisconnecting(ConnectionEvent connectionEvent)
        Description copied from interface: ConnectionListener
        As soon as any manager begins the process of disconnecting, or is in the process of being disconnected due to other issues with the server, this method will be called. The following error codes signify a reason for disconnect that will not result in automatic reconnection. DBCAPI_ERROR.MUST_UPGRADE DBCAPI_ERROR.WRONG_USERNAMEPASSWORD DBCAPI_ERROR.NOT_ENTITLED DBCAPI_ERROR.NOT_AUTHORIZED DBCAPI_ERROR.UPGRADEVERSION DBCAPI_ERROR.ADDRESS_CHANGE DBCAPI_ERROR.NOT_ENDOFDAY
        Specified by:
        onDisconnecting in interface ConnectionListener
        Parameters:
        connectionEvent - ConnectionEvent value with information.

      • onError

        public void onError(ConnectionEvent connectionEvent)
        Description copied from interface: ConnectionListener
        As soon as any manager fails in the process of connecting or disconnecting, this method will be called. The client should be reading the ConnectionException in this case and appropriately handle it.
        Specified by:
        onError in interface ConnectionListener
        Parameters:
        connectionEvent - ConnectionEvent value with information
